verdict: 7shifts: Choose 7shifts when restaurant scheduling, punches, tips, and POS sync are the job — not when you need general SMB WFM, a core HRIS, or an ATS. Scores use the HR editorial methodology from first-party research as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing.
strengths: Hospitality-native scheduling, tips, and POS sync
weaknesses: Not a general WFM outside restaurants
Free Comp limits not fully published
bestFor: Restaurants and hospitality groups that want scheduling, punches, tips, and POS in one WFM

Teams that will trial Pro for 14 days before Premium payroll

Core HRIS or structured ATS buyers

recommendation: Choose 7shifts when restaurant scheduling, punches, tips, and POS sync are the job — not when you need general SMB WFM, a core HRIS, or an ATS. Compare Homebase for general hourly SMB, Deputy for multi-industry compliance WFM, Connecteam for deskless hubs, and Toast-adjacent stacks for POS-first operators.

overallScoreRationale: Weighted average of the nine HR editorial criteria using the category weights (hiring/workforce fit 15, workflow depth 14, ease of use 12, integrations 12, value 12, mobile/frontline 10, scalability 9, analytics 8, AI 8), rounded to 1 decimal. Products are scored inside their job cluster — ATS, core HRIS, payroll/benefits, people-platform, frontline WFM, time & attendance, SOP training, and LMS peers are not forced into one undifferentiated ranking. Not a hands-on lab score, and affiliate economics are excluded.
